Get CEBL Games

Source: R/cebl.R
cebl_games.Rd

Schedule and results of one season (regular season and finals), with the Genius match id that joins play-by-play and shots; optionally one team's games.

Endpoint: GET https://api.data.cebl.ca/games/{season}/

Usage

cebl_games(season, team_id = NULL)

Arguments

season

(required) Season: the calendar year it is played in (May to August) = the sdv END year (2025 = the 2025 season). The CEBL's first season is 2019. A season with no data answers hoopR_no_data.

team_id

(default NULL) CEBL team id (team_id in cebl_teams): limits the rows to that team; the rows echo it.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Schedule and results of one season (regular season and finals), with the Genius match id that joins play-by-play and shots; optionally one team's games. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py cebl_games):

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason of the game: the year of start_time_utc (the calendar year = the sdv END year).
game_idintegerCEBL game id (its own key space: 568 in 2019, 8 digits from 2025, e.g. 14708701). No route is keyed by it; the Genius match id is in stats_url_en.
genius_match_idintegerGenius LiveStats match id parsed from the stats URL (the join to the genius family, organisation CEBL, where play-by-play and shots live). Derived from the URL, not fetched; null when the URL is absent.
start_time_utcPOSIXctScheduled tip-off, ISO 8601 in UTC ('2025-05-11T22:00:00Z').
competitioncharacterREGULAR (regular season) or FINALS (playoffs).
statuscharacterGame status. Observed: COMPLETE (final) and CANELLED (sic: cancelled; 1 game in 2025, 2 in 2026). The Stats Hub also knows SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, DELAYED and FINISHED.
periodintegerLast period played when the API sets it (seen only on a cancelled game, which carried period 3); null on a finished game.
venue_namecharacterArena name ('Edmonton EXPO Centre').
home_team_idintegerCEBL team id (its own key space; not a Genius id). Joins /teams/ id, the games' home_team_id / away_team_id, team_id in player rows and the team_id / vs_team_id params. A relocated or renamed franchise has a second id: the Stats Hub groups 15+56 (Saskatchewan Rattlers, Saskatoon Mamba), 17+53 (Calgary Surge, Guelph Nighthawks), 19+55 (Brampton, Hamilton Honey Badgers) and 16+54 (Vancouver, Fraser Valley Bandits). The home team.
home_team_namecharacterHome team full English name.
home_team_scoreintegerHome team final score. On the 3 cancelled games: null, 0 or a partial score; before tip-off unobserved.
away_team_idintegerCEBL team id (its own key space; not a Genius id). Joins /teams/ id, the games' home_team_id / away_team_id, team_id in player rows and the team_id / vs_team_id params. A relocated or renamed franchise has a second id: the Stats Hub groups 15+56 (Saskatchewan Rattlers, Saskatoon Mamba), 17+53 (Calgary Surge, Guelph Nighthawks), 19+55 (Brampton, Hamilton Honey Badgers) and 16+54 (Vancouver, Fraser Valley Bandits). The away team.
away_team_namecharacterAway team full English name.
away_team_scoreintegerAway team final score. On the 3 cancelled games: null, 0 or a partial score; before tip-off unobserved.
home_team_logo_urlcharacterURL of the home team's logo image as the games feed lists it (a team-level asset, the same on every game of that team in the season).
home_team_stats_url_encharacterHome team's cebl.ca stats page (English).
home_team_stats_url_frcharacterHome team's cebl.ca stats page (French).
away_team_logo_urlcharacterURL of the away team's logo image as the games feed lists it (a team-level asset, the same on every game of that team in the season).
away_team_stats_url_encharacterAway team's cebl.ca stats page (English).
away_team_stats_url_frcharacterAway team's cebl.ca stats page (French).
stats_url_encharacterGenius LiveStats box-score page, https://fibalivestats.dcd.shared.geniussports.com/u/CEBL/{matchId}/. The segment after /u/CEBL/ is the Genius match id: the join to genius-livestats/ (org CEBL), whose data/{matchId}/data.json holds the box score, play-by-play and shot chart. Only match 2600563 is banked there; the others are derived, and cancelled (CANELLED) games carry a filled-in URL whose data.json is unverified.
stats_url_frcharacterThe same Genius LiveStats page in French (.../u/CEBL/{matchId}/index_fr_FR.html).
cebl_stats_url_encharacterThe game page on cebl.ca, https://www.cebl.ca/game?id={matchId}: id is the Genius match id, not this row's id.
cebl_stats_url_frcharacterThe French cebl.ca game page (https://www.cebl.ca/fr-ca/game?id={matchId}).
tickets_url_encharacterTicket-sales page for the game (English).
tickets_url_frcharacterTicket-sales page for the game (French).
broadcast_partner_logo_urlscharacterLogo URLs of the game's broadcasters (TSN+, CEBL+, ...); 2 to 7 per game.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cebl_seasons().

See also
